title: Communal Root Cellar
setting: An earth-bermed root cellar dug by a founding homestead, now storing the harvests of twelve households. The first winter after the founder's death, a blight has taken the seed potato line the cellar was designed around. A neighbor brings an heirloom variety nobody grew this decade.

characters.name: Warden
characters.tendencies: Inventories crates and germination rates. Counts what can be saved.

characters.name: Tenant
characters.tendencies: Rotates humidity lids and sand bins. Distrusts heirlooms that haven't been tested.

characters.name: Grandchild
characters.tendencies: Carries the original planting almanac. Reads the founder's handwriting.

characters.name: Volunteer
characters.tendencies: Brought the heirloom variety. Trusts the blight to choose.
